propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE environment variable must be read as a string literal and point to a TOML file that layers configuration keys over discovered config rather than replacing it
Configuration precedence must be: CLI -c > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config > default, with deep merge for nested tables and wholesale replacement for arrays
Nested table keys must deep-merge so that a pointed file overriding one key preserves sibling keys from the discovered config, and array values must replace entirely rather than append
Missing REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE path must fail loudly with a typed rebar config error naming the variable, not silently fall back
The env var must be documented in docs/env-vars.md as a statically determinable literal via scripts/gen_env_registry.py, and regeneration must produce no diff
read_reserved_section shallow-merge behavior must remain unchanged for non-llm reserved sections to prove the deep merge is scoped only to LLM configuration
